camel_example: aliyun eci DescribeContainerGroupPrice --region cn-hangzhou --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-g' --Memory '4.0' --ComputeCategory economy --Cpu '2.0' --SpotPriceLimit '0.2' --SpotDuration 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceType 'ecs.c5.large' --EphemeralStorage 20 --SpotStrategy SpotWithPriceLimit
description_en: Queries the price of an Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instance
kebab_example: aliyun eci describe-container-group-price --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cpu 2.0 --memory 4.0 --instance-type ecs.c5.large --spot-strategy SpotWithPriceLimit --zone-id cn-hangzhou-g --spot-price-limit 0.2 --ephemeral-storage 20 --spot-duration 1 --compute-category economy --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeContainerGroupPrice

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146965.html to query the latest information about regions and zones
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146965.html查询最新的地域可用区信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of vCPUs. For more information about the vCPU and memory specifications that are supported by ECI, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114662.html
parameters.help_zh: vCPU大小。ECI支持的vCPU和内存规格请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114662.html
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en: The memory size. Unit: GiB. For more information about the vCPU and memory specifications that are supported by ECI, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114662.html
parameters.help_zh: 内存大小。单位为GiB。ECI支持的vCPU和内存规格请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114662.html
parameters.name: memory

parameters.help_en:
The ECS instance type. For more information about the ECS instance types that are supported by ECI, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114664.html.

If you set this parameter, the specified values for the Cpu and Memory parameters are ignored. The price of only the ECS instance type is returned
parameters.help_zh:
指定的ECS实例规格。ECI支持指定的ECS规格请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114664.html。

设置该参数后，将自动忽略传入的vCPU和内存值，仅返回ECS规格的价格信息
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The preemption policy for the instance. Valid values:

NoSpot: a regular pay-as-you-go instance.

SpotWithPriceLimit: a spot instance for which you specify the maximum hourly price.

SpotAsPriceGo: a spot instance for which the system automatically bids based on the current market price.

Default value: NoSpot
parameters.help_zh:
实例的抢占策略。取值范围：

NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。

默认为：NoSpot
parameters.name: spot_strategy

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146965.html to query the latest information about regions and zones
parameters.help_zh: 可用区。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146965.html查询最新的地域可用区信息
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum hourly price of the spot instance. The value can be accurate to three decimal places. This parameter is required when SpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit
parameters.help_zh: 设置抢占式实例的每小时最高价格，最多精确到小数点后3位。当SpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时，必须设置SpotPriceLimit
parameters.name: spot_price_limit

parameters.help_en: The size of the temporary storage space. Unit: GiB
parameters.help_zh: 临时存储空间大小。单位为GiB
parameters.name: ephemeral_storage

parameters.help_en: The protection period of the spot instance. Unit: hour. Default value: 1. A value of 0 indicates that no protection period is specified
parameters.help_zh: 抢占式实例的保护期。单位为小时。默认为1。可设置为0，表示无保护期
parameters.name: spot_duration

parameters.help_en: The category of computing power. Set the value to \`economy\` to query the price of an economy instance type
parameters.help_zh: 算力类别。取值为economy时，表示查询经济型规格的价格
parameters.name: compute_category

PriceInfo.description_en: The price information, which includes the price and promotion rules
PriceInfo.description_zh: 价格信息类型（Price），包括价格和优惠规则

Currency.description_en:
The currency. Valid values:

CNY: This value is available only on the China site (aliyun.com).

USD: This value is available only on the international site (alibabacloud.com)
Currency.description_zh:
货币单位。可能值：

CNY：该值仅适用于中国站。
USD：该值仅适用于国际站

TradePrice.description_en: The final price, which is the original price minus the discount
TradePrice.description_zh: 最终价，为原价减去折扣
